rights_apply_to: Acquired source collection objects and surfaces; not new patient approval or unpublished data

source_annotation_roles.prostate: Semi-automatic Profuse MRI outline, user-adjustable; accuracy user-dependent.
source_annotation_roles.target: Radiologist-traced suspicious MRI ROI; proximity does not guarantee cancer or a complete histological boundary.
source_annotation_roles.derived_SEG: Producer Slicer rasterization of source STL in reference MRI grid; not an independent native manual voxel mask.
source_annotation_roles.US: Separate source US; publisher-applied axis permutation and nonrigid registration do not provide actor-verified MRI/US native registration.
source_annotation_roles.scores: Source Likert-like scores comparable to older PI-RADS2 context; not current PI-RADS2.1 assignment.
